objective: V4.6 Explore Activation — parallel mode=explore path that clusters weakly related sparks into ephemeral themes with determinism, lane isolation, and sensitivity enforcement, without replacing precise top-K retrieval.
context: Architecture approved 2026-07-09 (Mr. Go). Spec: docs/V4.6_EXPLORE_ACTIVATION_RFC.md and docs/V4_COGNITIVE_SPEC_GAP_ANALYSIS.md Explore activation section. ChatGPT proposed activation/concepts/query-expansion; pressure-tested against shipped spine (spark_retrieval, patterns, spark_graph, sanitize/security) and minted V4.3–V4.5. Concepts are ephemeral only — no Concept table. Do NOT mint until V4.5 #374 completion lock is done. Do NOT amend open tickets #358–#374.
decisions: Mint only after ticket #374 (V4.5 cognitive completion lock) is done.
Cursor implements all V4.6 tickets when directed after mint.
mode=precise remains default; mode=explore is parallel only.
Clusters are ephemeral per-query objects; no concepts table in V4.6.
Extractive theme labels only; no LLM synthesis as default path.
Wire GET /api/cognitive/context and Actions cognitive.context — not GET /api/retrieve.
Reuse embed_text / spark_vec; no new embedding or ML clustering infra.
Lane-homogeneous clusters; sensitivity=max(members); sanitize before clustering.
Hard caps: max_candidates=100, max_clusters=5; deterministic sort (-score, spark_id).
Feature work stays out of crowley.py except thin facade re-exports.
patterns.py remains lifecycle pattern detection; explore does not replace it.
non_goals: Concept table, Concept CRUD, or user-named concepts
Replacing precise top-K retrieval or changing canonical score constants
LLM ranking, lane selection, or default cluster synthesis
Hooking or changing GET /api/retrieve legacy memory contract for explore
Graph DB or heavy ML clustering service
Silent explore in chat before V4.4 wire and V4.6 acceptance are green
risks: Cross-lane leakage if clustering skips lane split
Sensitive data amplification when weak private sparks cluster
Hallucinated themes if LLM synthesis sneaks in as default
DoS / latency from broad candidate pools without hard caps
Nondeterministic tests if cluster ordering is unstable
Premature mint before V4.3–V4.5 prerequisites ship
qa_expectations: Per ticket: focused tests in tests/test_cognitive_clustering.py and tests/test_activation_resolution.py. T4 security fixtures for lane isolation and sensitivity max. T6: docs/V4.6_EXPLORE_ACTIVATION_LOCK.md + acceptance that fragmented query yields themes without cross-lane leak; full unittest discovery green.
next_action: Do not mint until #374 done. After #374: set approval.status to approved if still needed, then scripts/codex_sync.py --create-tickets tickets/v4.6_explore_activation.json. Cursor claims T1 when directed.

approval.note: Architecture approved. MINT GATE: wait until V4.5 #374 completion lock is done. Do not run --create-tickets while V4.5 is open.

tickets.title: V4.6 T2: cognitive_clustering module
tickets.description: Add cognitive_clustering.py: group sparks by embedding similarity within a single lane, enforce max cluster size and similarity threshold, compute centroid as mean of sorted member embeddings, stable ordering. Must be fast at SQLite scale and degrade gracefully with empty/small pools. Files: cognitive_clustering.py, tests/test_cognitive_clustering.py. Depends on V4.6 T1.
tickets.non_goals: Persistence; LLM themes; cross-lane clusters; graph DB.
acceptance: Same input embeddings produce identical cluster membership in CROWLEY_TEST_MODE
Clusters never mix lanes
max_clusters and max_cluster_size caps enforced
Centroid uses sorted member order for determinism
tests/test_cognitive_clustering.py passes

tickets.title: V4.6 T3: activation_resolution path
tickets.description: Implement activation_resolution() in spark_retrieval.py: broad retrieve (limit 50-100, low floor) → sanitize candidates → lane-split → cognitive_clustering → cluster_score (semantic * confidence * recency) → top 3-5 themes with extractive labels and supporting_spark_ids. Fallback to precise when fewer than 2 viable clusters. Reuse embed_text/spark_vec. Files: spark_retrieval.py, cognitive_clustering.py, spark_sanitize.py, tests/test_activation_resolution.py. Depends on V4.6 T2.
tickets.non_goals: LLM synthesis; Concept persistence; changing precise score constants.
acceptance: Explore returns clusters with theme, lane, supporting_spark_ids, confidence, sensitivity
max_candidates<=100 and max_clusters<=5 enforced
Fewer than 2 viable clusters sets fallback_used and returns precise results
Precise path regression suite still passes
tests/test_activation_resolution.py covers explore and fallback

tickets.title: V4.6 T4: explore security gates
tickets.description: Enforce explore security: lane-homogeneous clusters only; cluster.sensitivity=max(members); omit or block synthesis when exposure_class=private or high without auth; sanitize candidate content BEFORE clustering; reuse spark_security and spark_sanitize. Files: spark_retrieval.py, cognitive_clustering.py, spark_security.py, spark_sanitize.py, tests/test_activation_resolution.py. Depends on V4.6 T3.
tickets.non_goals: New crypto; weakening V4.5 sensitivity rules.
acceptance: Cross-lane candidate pools never produce a mixed-lane cluster
Cluster sensitivity equals max member sensitivity
Private/high members blocked from explore payload without authorization
Sanitize runs before clustering (instruction-like content neutralized)
Security-focused activation tests pass
